content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Mandi Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Interested candidates should report to the SBB office on 29th September 2026 at 10 am. No candidate reporting will be considered after 12 noon on the same day of walk-in-interview. Candidates should bring their detailed CV having personal details, academic qualifications, research experience, publications, name, affiliation and mobile number, email address of two referees, information regarding educational qualifications indicating the percentage of marks/division, details of work experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report on the specified date, which is 29th September 2026. There is no separate last date for application submission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Science (B.sc) degree from a UGC recognized university with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 20,000/- per month plus 9% HRA for the first year, and Rs. 23,000/- per month plus 9% HRA for the second and third years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a walk-in interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and suitability for the research project.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview for IIT Mandi Project Assistant recruitment scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the SBB office, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, Mandi - 175075.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their detailed CV, personal details, academic qualifications, research experience, publications, names and contact details of two referees, and educational mark sheets/certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should report by 10 am on 29th September 2026. No candidate reporting after 12 noon on the same day will be considered.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, specifically for research purposes at IIT Mandi.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Mandi offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
